Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #17: M92–M95: moving hold, Route tab grouped by category, Undo / Reset to default

1. The Route tab is now grouped by category: Buffs, Heals, Mitigation and Utility. It opens with every group collapsed, and each header shows how many of its actions are routed ("all on" or "7 of 8 on").
2. Each action is one line: its icon, name, on/off switch and target order. Click a line to edit its targets; only one action is open at a time. "Expand all" / "Collapse all" sit next to the heading.
3. The target editor has "Undo", which steps back through your changes to the open action, and "Reset to default", which restores the shipped order at once. Undo clears when you open another action or leave the tab.
4. The moving flag now stays on for half a second after you stop. A quick left-right strafe no longer makes the rotation fall back to a cast for a moment.

Minor: the tab's description is now one line, "Where each action gets routed to"; groups and lines can be opened in combat while edits stay locked; an inspector's Route button opens straight to its action; every Route entry in the encyclopedia names its category.
